remarks: Located just under 15 mins to multiple Metro North train stations, all major highways, shopping, dining, downtown Westport, Calf Pasture Beach, SONO, several gyms and a 50-meter pool club, right next door... This 4-Story Townhome features an open floor plan on the main living level, perfect for entertaining. Living room with gas fireplace opens to the kitchen with a large center island, quartz counter-tops and stainless-steel appliances. A separate dining room, half bath and access to the deck complete the main floor. Upstairs you will find a bedroom with large closet and hall bath. The primary suite features a vaulted ceiling, full bath with double sinks and walk-in shower, as well as access to the private loft; making this a perfect home office or dressing room. Gleaming hardwood floors and crown moldings throughout. 1 car attached garage, foyer and den with sliders to patio complete the ground level. 1 reserved parking space and plenty of guest parking on the cul-de-sac. Set up your appointment to preview today!
